description: Recent Aave V4 loan swaps (borrow swaps), launched 2026-11-12 on Ethereum, Base, and Avalanche via CoW Swap. Reads ActivityType.BORROW_SWAP from the Aave V4 API and cross-checks Ethereum/Base against same-transaction REPAY+BORROW rows in the V4 subgraphs (CoW flash-loan router 0x9da8b48441583a2b93e2ef8213aad0ec0b392c69 and settlement 0x9008D19f58AAbD9eD0D60971565AA8510560ab41). Returns from-asset, to-asset, amounts, user, tx, time, and chain. Read-only. Subgraph cross-check needs GRAPH_API_KEY and is reported in crossCheck.errors when unavailable. Avalanche has no subgraph cross-check.

chainId.description: Optional chain filter (1=Ethereum, 8453=Base, 43114=Avalanche). Omit for all three chains where Aave loan swaps are live.

windowHours.description: Only swaps newer than this many hours

name: get_v4_loan_swaps
